name: Week 35 Pull — Pull-Ups and the Incline Curl Take the Spotlight
description: Same pull day, same loads. The pull-up and the incline curl take the spotlight; the pulldown, the face pull and the cable work keep their places. The warmup rotates thread-the-needle to low-lunge thoracic rotations; the band pull-apart, the bicep pre-load and the shrug stay.

dayOverview.theme: Same pull day at the same length. The pull-up and the incline curl take the spotlight, and the row pyramid, the bench block and the cable block hold their loads.

spotlights.why: The 3-second lowering back to an active hang is the lift. Pack down before the elbows bend, and the set ends when the tempo breaks.
The upper arm stays flat on the pad and the bottom of the rep is controlled. Left first, and the right matches the left's clean count.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: Spotlights go to the DB row and the high cable curl next.
watchpoints: 🛑 keep it shy — the cue is the cap: pull-ups, DB row, chest-supported row, lat pulldown, incline curl. Grip and position lifts where the honest ceiling is the rep the cue breaks.
🔥 near-failure last set OK: reverse fly, face pull, high cable curl, cable crunch. Isolation work where form holds at the limit.
**⭐ IF THE SHOULDERS CRACKLE, TAKE THE SHRUG AGAIN BETWEEN PULL-UP SETS.** It is the same behind-back shrug from the warmup, with a kettlebell or a DB pair. Optional, not a mandatory round.
**Say which shoulder** if either gets noisy. Mention any tiredness that ends a set.
**The incline curl is CHEST-SUPPORTED, PREACHER-STYLE.** Bench a notch steeper than 45°, armpit and the back of the upper arm flat on the pad, arm hanging down the face of the pad.

**The left curl spot:** a twinge on set 1 that clears by set 2 is the pattern you know. Stop the curl if it does not clear by set 2, if it is sharper than before, or if it is still there the next morning, and say so.
Log both sides on the DB row: where the left and right end on the 95.
**Band-pull-apart is the pull-day shoulder anchor.** Keep the warmup lean — no extra band volume.

**Two rows, so the shoulders and grip get a second round of work.** Do the DB row pyramid first; the chest-supported row is the lighter, supported one, and the first thing to cut if the shoulder talks.

sets.name: Warmup (Pull-Up Bar Station) + Bicep Pre-Load
sets.notes: Lean by design. **The bicep pre-load stays** — a light set plus one still hold, before anything hangs off the elbow. **Note where the shrug is: you will want it again between pull-up sets.**

exercises.notes: **The shoulder anchor for pull day.** Light band, slow, squeeze the blades together without shrugging.
Low lunge, back knee down, hand inside the front foot, then open the chest to the ceiling. Opens the upper back before the bar.
Deep core before anything loaded.
Passive hang. **Your first read on both shoulders today** — note whether either one is noisy, and which.

**It helped, so it stays.**
- **Light DBs, nowhere near failure, left side first**
- **Then hold a light DB still at about 90° for 30 seconds on the left**, and the same on the right
- The hold is the point: a still, moderate load is the calmest thing you can hand an irritable tendon, and it goes in before the bar takes your bodyweight

**Protective activation — do this before anything loaded.** 40-50lb pair or a kettlebell, behind the back, straight up and down, squeeze at the top.

**This is the same movement you will reach for between pull-up sets if the shoulders crackle.** Know where the weight is before you start.

sets.name: 🔆 Pull-Ups — 4 Sets, 3s Eccentric, Shrug Reset When Needed 🛑
sets.notes:
Bodyweight, 4 sets to form failure, 3s eccentric on every rep, straight bar, full 2-minute rests. Repeat the tempo without chasing reps.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the lowering is the lift.**

- **Active hang to start**, shoulders pulled down away from the ears
- **Pack down before the elbows bend**, then pull the elbows to the ribs with the chest leading to the bar
- **3 seconds down, back to an active hang** — not a collapsed one
- Stop when the tempo breaks or the shoulders shrug up
- Use the behind-back shrug between sets only if a shoulder gets noisy
- Three sets is fine if a shoulder starts talking

**Too tired for the 3s lowering?** Four sets at normal tempo, one up and one down, is a fair day.

**Reflection:** did the 3s lowering survive the last rep of the last set, or did the descent speed up?

exercises.notes:
Bodyweight, 4 sets, **3s eccentric every rep.** Straight bar, 2 min rest.
- Pack down before the elbows bend
- Set ends when the tempo breaks
- **Shrug reset between sets if the shoulders crackle**
- **Say which shoulder**
- Write the numbers, leave them alone

sets.name: DB Rack / Bench Block — 🔆 Incline Curl → DB Row (3 Rounds)
sets.notes:
Both movements stay at one adjustable bench. **Left first on the curl.** The row pyramid stays at 75 → 85 → 95, one set each side per round; record where each side ends on the 95.

**The left curl spot:** the 25s are the load. A twinge on set 1 that clears by set 2 is the pattern you know. **Stop the curl** if it does not clear by set 2, if it is sharper than before, or if it is still there the next morning, and say so.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 25lb both arms, 3 sets of 10 each side, plus one easy left-side warm-up set. Left first.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the upper arm stays on the pad and the bottom is controlled.**

- Bench a notch steeper than 45°, chest and upper arm supported
- Upper arm flat on the pad the whole rep
- Stop a few degrees short of elbow lockout
- Slow eccentric; never drop into the bottom
- No shoulder swing
- **Stop if the set-1 twinge does not clear by set 2 or is sharper than before**

**Reflection:** did the left clear by set 2, and did the right match the left's clean count?

**LOAD:** pyramid **75 → 85 → 95**, one set each side per round.

- **Chest supported on the bench**, spine long, no twisting to finish
- **Elbow drives back past the ribs**, not out to the side
- **Crush the handle from rep 1** rather than letting the grip fade in
- Slow eccentric, full stretch at the bottom
- **Log where the left and the right end on the 95.** No straps

sets.name: Bench Block, Second Half — Chest-Supported Row → Reverse Fly (2 Rounds)
sets.notes: Same adjustable bench, no walking. Both are supported, so they are the lighter half of the bench work.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 45lb pair, 2 sets of 12, slow eccentric.
- **Chest stays glued to the pad.** The moment it peels off, the low back has joined in and the mid-back has stopped working
- **Start the rep with the shoulder blades**, not the arms
- **Elbows drive past the ribs at ~45°**, not flared to 90
- **Slow eccentric to a full stretch**, letting the blades come apart at the bottom
- **No shrug.** If the traps take over, the load is beating the position

**LOAD:** 20lb pair, 2 sets of 12-15, slow eccentric.
- **Soft elbows at a fixed angle** — bending and straightening turns it into a row
- **Lead with the pinkies**, thumbs down
- **Shoulders packed DOWN** — the traps want this one badly
- Slow all the way back down
- Last set may run near failure 🔥

sets.name: Lat Pulldown — Regular Machine 180 or Dual Pulley 80/Side 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 3 sets of 8-12, slow eccentric. Take whichever station is free and **log which**:
- Regular machine: **180**
- Dual cable pulley: **80 per side**

- Pack the shoulders down before the elbows move
- Start the pull from the armpits
- Let the bar pull you up into a real stretch, then slow down

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** regular machine 180, or dual pulley 80/side.
- Pack down before the elbows bend
- Start from the armpits
- Chest up, ribs down
- Slow eccentric to a full stretch
- No leaning back

sets.name: Face Pull — 62.5 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 62.5, 3 sets of 20.

- **Hands finish beside the ears, elbows HIGH**
- **Rotate the knuckles back** at the end of every rep
- Traps quiet; the last set can run near failure

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 62.5.
- Hands finish beside the ears, **elbows high**
- **Knuckles rotate back** at the end of every rep
- Hold a beat, slow return
- Elbows lead, hands follow, traps quiet

sets.name: High Cable Curl — Regular Pulley 62.5 × 4 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** regular pulley 62.5 for all four sets, 10-12 each side. If you use the cable column instead, its separate ladder is 220 / 230 / 240 / 250.

- Single arm, cable high, elbow fixed
- Squeeze at the top and return slowly
- Do not mix the pulley and column scales

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** regular pulley 62.5 on all four sets; cable-column alternative 220 / 230 / 240 / 250. Log the station.
- Single arm, elbow fixed
- No elbow drift
- Squeeze at the top, slow return

sets.name: Cable Crunch 🔥
sets.notes: Same cable stations as the curl. Pick by availability and log which; the two scales do not convert.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:**
- Rope pulley: **77.5** (82.5 is the ceiling)
- Cable column: **150**
Pick by availability and **log which**.

- **Curl the spine, don't hinge the hips** — the hips stay put and the ribs come toward the pelvis
- **Slow return**, resist all the way back up
- Arms are hooks, not levers
- Last set may run near failure 🔥

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Fascia/Recovery Block
sets.notes: Five minutes, every gym day. Slow breathing throughout — the downshift is as much the point as the tissue.

exercises.notes: 30s each arm, elbow at MID height.
Passive. Let the shoulders decompress after the pulling.
30s each side.
45s each side.
Slow breathing. End here.

tips: Pull-ups: 3s lowering, back to an active hang. A too-tired day gets four clean sets at normal tempo.
Incline curl: left first, upper arm flat on the pad, right matches the left's clean count.
Pulldown: regular machine 180 or dual pulley 80/side. Log which.
Left curl spot: stop if the set-1 twinge does not clear by set 2, is sharper than before, or is still there the next morning.
If the shoulders crackle on the bar, take the warmup shrug again between sets.
Log where the left and the right end on the 95 row.
